candidates: Avoid CSS selector overrides in a parent/wrapper styled component that target internals of a child component (e.g. `table { backgroundColor: ... }` inside a wrapper div). Components should accept styling customization only through explicit APIs such as props or a `className` prop. If the child component lacks the necessary API for context-specific styling, extend the child component with that API rather than reaching into it with an ancestor selector.

When a styling fix is correct for all usages of a component (not just one specific consumer), apply the change in the component's own definition rather than as a context-specific override in a single consumer. Before scoping a styling change narrowly to one usage context, verify whether other usages of the same component would also benefit from the change.
